zh.title: 邮件与通知
zh.description: 设置营销邮件发件主体、预览统一页脚，并由用户自己管理接收偏好。
zh.previewNote: 预览不会发送邮件。以下链接仅属于当前 Root 账户；请勿转发。
zh.preferenceDescription: 选择你愿意接收的内容。注册、付费或加入团队不会自动订阅营销邮件。
zh.serviceNotice: 这些设置不会取消套餐。必要的账户、安全与账单通知仍会发送。
zh.unsubscribeDescription: 确认后将停止此邮箱的全部营销类别。无需登录或填写原因。
zh.unsubscribeAction: 确认取消全部营销邮件
zh.unsubscribed: 已停止接收全部营销邮件
zh.invalidLink: 链接无效或已过期。你可以登录账户后管理邮件偏好。
zh.controlsBody: 营销类别默认关闭，由用户本人主动选择。管理员不能替其他用户开启订阅。套餐变更、到期和用量通知应使用独立服务通知流程。
zh.scopeNote: 公告活动与欢迎步骤只在明确启用或确认入队后发送；套餐、用量和到期通知仍由独立服务流程处理。
zh.noR: 用户通过链接自助设置，无需回复邮件。
zh.emptyIdentity: 先填写并保存真实发件主体，再生成预览。
zh.consent: 保存即确认按以上选择接收邮件；可以随时通过邮件链接更改或取消。
zh.campaignDescription: 新特性、APP 版本和最新公告统一按产品更新偏好发送，每位收件人单独投递。
zh.subject: 邮件标题
zh.excluded: 未授权、拒收或频控排除
zh.queueWarning: 仅向当前已授权且符合频率的用户发送；加入队列后可取消尚未发出的邮件。
zh.noCampaigns: 还没有公告活动。创建草稿后，先预览再确认入队。
zh.senderMissing: SMTP 尚未配置：可保存草稿，无法启动发送。
zh.workerManual: 当前运行模式未启用后台发送，请使用“处理待发队列”或经授权的调度调用。
zh.campaignLimits: 最多每人 7 天 1 封、30 天 3 封；月度摘要每 UTC 自然月最多 1 封。单次活动最多 10,000 人。
zh.saveBeforePreview: 编辑后请先保存草稿，再重新预览受众。
zh.onboardingTitle: 新用户欢迎与分步引导
zh.onboardingDescription: 仅从每个步骤启用时刻起的新注册用户开始。注册和 OAuth 新建账户均可触发，同一步骤每位用户只入队一次。
zh.helloLabel: 第 1 步 · Hello 欢迎
zh.first_stepsLabel: 第 2 步 · 开始使用
zh.discover_moreLabel: 第 3 步 · 进一步探索
zh.helloNotice: Hello 是一次性账户服务引导，请勿加入促销或升级推销。启用后，新注册用户会自动排队。
zh.tutorialNotice: 后续教程需要用户主动选择“使用技巧与教程”。顺序与用户频率会在发送前检查；达到频控时自动顺延。停用步骤将跳过尚未发送的邮件。
zh.templateVariables: 支持 {{name}}；正文按纯文本安全渲染。所有动作链接都需要 HTTPS。
zh.ackUnknown: 我已核对 SMTP 投递记录，并了解重试可能重复发送
zh.unknownNotice: SMTP 结果不确定时不会自动重发。请先核对供应商记录，再决定是否重新排队。
zh.suppressionDescription: 根据 SMTP/邮件服务商的退信与投诉记录手动登记；名单内邮箱的营销与欢迎邮件都会被跳过。

templates.subject: Hello {{name}}，欢迎使用 XWorkmate
templates.body:
你好 {{name}}，

你的账户已创建。先打开账户设置，检查邮箱、安全选项和当前套餐。

接下来可以根据需要连接设备或配置工作空间。遇到问题时，可通过支持入口联系我们。

templates.subject: 开始使用：完成你的第一次连接
templates.body:
你好 {{name}}，

这一步可以帮助你开始使用：
1. 打开区域入口池。
2. 按实际账户权限选择可用入口。
3. 在 APP 中完成连接，并回到账户页查看状态。

templates.subject: 下一步：配置你的工作空间
templates.body:
你好 {{name}}，

完成基础设置后，可以打开接口集成页面，按需要连接你使用的服务。

只添加你需要的集成，凭据请通过页面提供的安全方式填写。

en.title: Email & notifications
en.description: Configure the marketing sender identity and footer. Recipients manage their own preferences.
en.previewNote: No email will be sent. These links belong only to the current Root account. Do not forward them.
en.preferenceDescription: Choose what you want to receive. Signing up, paying or joining a team does not subscribe you to marketing.
en.serviceNotice: These settings do not cancel your plan. Necessary account, security and billing notices will continue.
en.unsubscribeDescription: This will stop all marketing categories for this address. No login or reason is required.
en.unsubscribed: You have unsubscribed from all marketing
en.invalidLink: This link is invalid or expired. Sign in to manage your email preferences.
en.controlsBody: Marketing categories are off by default and require the recipient to opt in. Administrators cannot subscribe other users. Plan changes, expiry and usage notices use separate service notification flows.
en.scopeNote: Campaigns and welcome steps send only after explicit activation or queue confirmation. Plan, usage and expiry notices use separate service flows.
en.noR: Recipients use self-service links. No email reply is required.
en.error: The request failed. Please try again.
en.emptyIdentity: Save the actual sender identity before generating a preview.
en.consent: Saving confirms your choices. You can change them or unsubscribe at any time using the links in our emails.
en.campaignDescription: Feature news, app releases and announcements follow product-update consent. Every recipient gets an individual message.
en.subject: Email subject
en.excluded: Excluded by consent, suppression or caps
en.queueWarning: Only currently consenting, eligible recipients are included. You can cancel messages that have not started sending.
en.noCampaigns: No campaigns yet. Save a draft, preview it, then confirm queueing.
en.senderMissing: SMTP is not configured. Drafts can be saved but sending cannot start.
en.workerManual: Background sending is disabled in this runtime. Process the queue manually or through an authorized scheduler call.
en.campaignLimits: At most one marketing email per 7 days and three per 30 days. Monthly digests are capped at one per UTC calendar month. Up to 10,000 recipients per campaign.
en.saveBeforePreview: Save your edits, then preview the audience again.
en.onboardingDescription: Only accounts created after each step is enabled are enrolled. Password and OAuth signup are supported. Each step is queued once per account.
en.helloNotice: Hello is a one-time account-service guide. Do not include promotions or upgrade sales. Enabling enrolls future new accounts.
en.tutorialNotice: Follow-up tutorials require explicit tutorial consent. Step order and recipient frequency are checked before sending; capped steps are deferred. Disabling a step stops its unsent messages.
en.templateVariables: Supports {{name}}. Content is safely rendered as plain text. All action URLs must use HTTPS.
en.ackUnknown: I checked SMTP records and understand that retrying may send a duplicate
en.unknownNotice: Unknown SMTP outcomes are never retried automatically. Check the provider record before requeueing.
en.suppressionDescription: Record provider-confirmed bounces or complaints. Addresses on this list are skipped for marketing and welcome messages.

templates.subject: Hello {{name}}, welcome to XWorkmate
templates.body:
Hello {{name}},

Your account is ready. Start in account settings to review your email, security options and current plan.

Then connect a device or configure your workspace when ready. Contact support if you need help.

templates.subject: Get started: make your first connection
templates.body:
Hello {{name}},

1. Open the regional entry pool.
2. Choose an entry available to your account.
3. Connect in the app, then review your status in account settings.

templates.subject: Next: configure your workspace
templates.body:
Hello {{name}},

After the basic setup, visit integrations to connect the services you use. Add only the integrations you need, and enter credentials through the secure controls provided.
